purpose: Verify that the known Nav2/runtime configuration is retained robot-visibly without leaking evaluator-only intervention or outcome truth before final-study freeze.
required_runtime_manifest: container image reference, ID, and repo digest
BT XML and Nav2 parameter file hashes plus exact Git commit/path relationship
umbrella capture/runtime-manifest builder and land/Nav2 harness hashes
umbrella, astro_dock, and crane_ml checkout identities
player/build/managed-assembly hashes and explicit source-commit limit
effective scene, command interface, and LiDAR frame without evaluator-only intervention values
pass_rule: Pass only if capture/manifest.json hashes capture/runtime_manifest.json exactly; all required fields are populated; all source artifacts are byte-identical to their declared Git objects; run IDs agree; the F/G/H presentation rebuild accepts; and forbidden evaluator keys or actual intervention/expected-outcome values are absent.
navigation_outcome_rule: Retain and report navigation outcome, but do not tune or repeat e042 based on it; outcome is irrelevant to the provenance calibration pass.
next_step_rule: Freeze the final provenance design only after this calibration passes. Diagnose a failure without rerunning e042.
